claim_assessments.support: Existing monoclinic Cu4(SO4)(OH)6 brochantite and orthorhombic Cu2Cl(OH)3 atacamite remain distinct mineral concepts; no constituent criticality transfer.
claim_assessments.limits: Authority sources were read in prior accepted reviews, not reacquired here; no new identity/criticality claim.

claim_assessments.support: Synthetic UV-treated starting minerals; live unnamed vineyard B. bassiana; mineral-free MA growth comparator; labelled 10/20/50 series; atacamite growth inhibited at highest loading.
claim_assessments.limits: Loading units, original powder phase purity, exact temperature/pH and matched sterile/killed/acid-specific mineral controls unresolved; absent atacamite high-dose product bar not measured zero.

claim_assessments.support: Three-month dried/ground/pressed culture XRD semiquantification; copper oxalate dihydrate/quartz calibration; source assigns moolooite with n<1.
claim_assessments.limits: Fraction of dry treated mycelium versus dried whole culture versus amount of copper unclear; hydration/purity/completeness not independently measured; no recovered metal mass balance.
